description: Wheelchair ramp blocked by parked vehicle.
Uneven footpath surface makes wheelchair movement difficult.
Side entrance has three steps and no ramp alternative.
Construction barriers block the tactile crossing.

Cracked footpath slabs near the market entrance.
Standing water at the base of the approach ramp.
Two-wheelers parked across the ramp entrance.
